blocks.text: **Control flow analysis and unreachable code (never)** — Control flow analysis and unreachable code (never) lets TypeScript narrow unions after runtime checks — typeof, in, instanceof, user-defined predicates, and assert functions.. TypeScript checks this at compile time; emitted JavaScript still runs with the same runtime rules as plain JS. Read the glossary, study the snippets, then trace one example in DevTools or with `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` / Node REPL.
